title: Iwahori–Whittaker Satake equivalence in positive characteristic for reductive groups admitting a simple-root-unit cocharacter
author: Roman Bezrukavnikov; Dennis Gaitsgory; Ivan Mirković; Simon Riche; Laura Rider
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 6 (2019), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.104
difficulty_reason: The local argument transfers the geometric Casselman–Shalika vanishing to the translated Iwahori orbit and controls top compactly supported cohomology integrally through the full modular triple. Its new adjunction, translation and Verdier-duality computation converts that into the precise vanishing between the convolution image and costandard sheaves. The standard-object maps are then proved isomorphisms over all three coefficient rings before the complete standard/costandard derived-generator argument establishes the selected categorical equivalence.
work: An Iwahori-Whittaker model for the Satake category
